timon.label: GitHub Copilot
timon.description: Runs missions on the GitHub Copilot CLI with the user's own Copilot subscription, personal or corporate.
timon.author: Timon

standaloneInstaller.label: Copilot CLI
standaloneInstaller.posix: case `uname` in D*)d=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin;;*)d=/usr/local/bin:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin;;esac;h=$HOME;n=${NVM_DIR:-$h/.nvm}/versions/node;PATH=$PATH:$h/.local/bin:$d:$h/.volta/bin:$h/.npm-global/bin;for v in `ls "$n" 2>/dev/null|sed -nE 's/^v?(((0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.){2}(0|[1-9][0-9]*))$/\1 &/p'|sort -t. -rn -k1,1 -k2,2 -k3|cut -d\  -f2`;do PATH=$PATH:$n/$v/bin;done;if command -v copilot>/dev/null;then copilot update;else curl -fsSL https://gh.io/copilot-install|bash;fi
standaloneInstaller.windows: [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'User') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'Machine'), 'Process'); if (Get-Command copilot -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { copilot update; exit (Get-Variable LASTEXITCODE -ValueOnly) } else { winget install -e --source winget --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements --id GitHub.Copilot }
